purpose: Regression and implementation context for CiteLadder Site Health page-type classification plus internal link graph / crawl-relative Internal PageRank.
important_limitations: This is NOT a captured production CiteLadder crawl export. The production worker was not executable from this environment.

The 200 URLs come from current live site inventories/sitemaps. Current-classifier expectations are derived from the exact main-branch deterministic classifier. Representative template pages were live-fetched to validate failure mechanisms.
Do not turn domain names, brand names, Best&Less-specific paths, Shopify-specific names, SKUs, or these URLs into production classifier rules. They are eval data only.
Bulk Firecrawl crawl was rate-limited (HTTP 429), so do not infer page-by-page body facts that were not explicitly captured.

confirmed_regressions.current_failure: The /Categories/ path provides category=0.8. Without price+cart content heuristic, product cannot override; Product schema is advisory and cannot beat the path. A real PDP can therefore become category.

confirmed_regressions.current_behavior: content price+cart marker can override /Categories/ category path

confirmed_regressions.current_failure: No category route token in path; product heuristic should not fire because listing cards are not the primary entity. Without CollectionPage schema the current classifier can fall to other.
No recognized path signal for refund-policy. Whole-body price+cart heuristic sees recommendation cards and can classify the policy page as product.
The generic /help/ path is classified as FAQ even when the page is a how-to guide.
privacypolicy is not an exact privacy/privacy-policy path segment, so the path classifier misses it.
Generic /pages/ route provides no guide signal; visible title/H1 semantics are currently unused.
A multi-location locator is not a single local-location page and generic /pages/ provides no service signal.

report_semantics_guardrails.required_change: Do not score optional schema recommendations as HIGH-weight defects merely because a page was classified into a type. Schema expected/recommended rules must distinguish defects from advisory opportunities.
report_semantics_guardrails.reason: Current schema_expected_for_type is HIGH severity, weight 3.0, default finding_class=defect for every non-other page kind.

report_semantics_guardrails.required_change: A recommendation carousel must never make an informational/policy/guide page a product page.
Category detection must work for flat slugs using listing structure, not require /category/ or /collections/.
Single-location pages and store-locator indexes must not share the same LocalBusiness requirement.
Type-specific scoring must not blindly trust a path winner when primary-entity evidence materially conflicts with it.

required_primary_entity_signals: top-level/primary Product structured-data node cardinality and Offer evidence
purchase/variant/SKU controls scoped to primary product region rather than whole page body
listing signals such as result count + sort/filter + repeated product-card/link structure
semantic title/H1 fallback for trust-policy, guide, about/contact and service families
single-location evidence (address/telephone/hours or one LocalBusiness entity) distinct from locator/index pages

regression_thresholds.unknown_page_behavior: Fail closed to other when evidence remains weak or conflicting; do not invent a confident type.

link_graph_acceptance.data_source: Only existing crawl facts and persistence; no external data or refetch.
link_graph_acceptance.edge_source: SiteFetchArtifact.normalized_facts internal links produced by fact_links.py
link_graph_acceptance.node_identity: existing SiteUrl/SiteUrlObservation identities and existing normalization; do not create a second URL normalizer
link_graph_acceptance.graph_scope: per crawl; metrics are crawl-relative and must state analyzed node count/coverage

pagerank.edge_policy: Use unique resolved followable internal source->target edges; keep nofollow/sponsored edges for diagnostics but exclude them from default authority flow.
pagerank.dangling_policy: Redistribute dangling mass uniformly across eligible graph nodes.
pagerank.determinism: Sort node IDs/normalized URLs before iteration and tie-breaking.

required_ui: Pages table sortable by Internal Authority, inbound links and outbound links
Per-URL Links tab: authority summary + top inbound source pages + top outbound target pages
Crawl-level Link Graph view: top-authority nodes first, bounded graph rendering, filters by page kind/depth
Tooltip: Internal Authority is crawl-relative internal link equity, not Google PageRank, Moz PA, or an external authority score
